name: ruko-ai-tools
description: AI workflow toolkit: run a dev task through the full spec-to-ship cycle (flow), strip duplicate and vacuous tests under a coverage guard (clean-tests), group changes into logical Conventional Commits (do-commits), rebuild branch history from main (pretty-commit-from-main), and draft PR titles & summaries (pr). Plus standalone design and debugging commands adapted from mattpocock/skills: architecture review (improve-codebase-architecture, with codebase-design, grilling and domain-modeling), bug diagnosis (diagnosing-bugs), throwaway prototypes (prototype) and session handoff (handoff).
